title: Remote mounts for the AST refresh (superseded by layers-ref)
location: cat-mount-v1-<hash>, in the calling IG repository's Actions cache
holds: /home/runner/.cache/cat-mount: the layers the lock pins, as mount-from-lock fetched them
producer: ig-ast-refresh.yml, every run that misses the key

stateInputs.how: not yet derived from a recorded read set; the producer may read state:mount graphs

savePolicy: any run that misses the key
verify: mount-from-lock checks each mounted layer against the lock's digests, so a stale entry only costs a fetch
notes: Superseded by the layers cache ref (`layers-ref`, cat-harness-tools): once the IG repositories mount through it, this step is removed rather than kept beside it. The IG repositories above this layer call it through this reusable workflow.
